items.title: State Urgency Legislation to continue to allow remote meetings during the COVID-19 Emergency
items.decision: adopt renewed findings under State Urgency Legislation to continue to
items.text: Adopt renewed findings under State Urgency Legislation to continue to allow remote meetings during the COVID-19 Emergency; continue remote meetings for the next 30 days; and direct the Commission Secretary to agendize a similar resolution at a Commission Meeting within the next 30 days

items.title: Approval of the Minutes: October 26, 2021 Regular Meeting and October 29, 2021 Special Meeting
First Amendment to the Prepayment and Collection Agreement between the Bay Area Water Supply and Conservation Agency (BAWSCA) and the City and County of San Francisco
items.decision: approve the Consent Calendar items 9a through 9c
items.text: Discussion and possible action to approve the First Amendment to the Prepayment and Collection Agreement between the Bay Area Water Supply and Conservation Agency (BAWSCA) and the City and County of San Francisco, dated as of October 1, 2021 (“First Amendment”); and authorize the General Manager to execute the First Amendment. Under the First Amendment, a new annual fee will be charged to BAWSCA to recover SFPUC administrative costs related to services provided by the SFPUC to BAWSCA under the Agreement

items.title: Award Contract No. WD-2871, Sunol Valley Water Treatment Plant and Chloramination Facility Aqua Ammonia Structural Repairs and Tank Replacement, in the amount of $1,769,014
items.decision: approve the Consent Calendar items 9a through 9c
items.text: Approve the plans and specifications and award Contract No. WD-2871, Sunol Valley Water Treatment Plant and Chloramination Facility Aqua Ammonia Structural Repairs and Tank Replacement, in the amount of $1,769,014, with a duration of 547 consecutive calendar days, to the responsible bidder submitting the lowest responsive bid, Cal State Constructors, to upgrade the aqua ammonia chemical feed systems at the Sunol Valley Chloramination Facility and Sunol Valley Water Treatment Plant including bracing structural elements; replacing two aqua ammonia chemical tanks and tank pedestal supports; and upgrading related instrumentation and controls systems

items.title: Award Contract No. WW-704, Various Locations Sewer Replacement No. 9, in the amount of $3,898,770
items.decision: approve the Consent Calendar items 9a through 9c
items.text: Approve the plans and specifications and award Contract No. WW-704, Various Locations Sewer Replacement No. 9, in the amount of $3,898,770, and with a duration of 310 consecutive calendar days to the responsible bidder submitting the lowest responsive bid, JDB and Sons Construction, Inc. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act, pursuant to Section 31.04(h) of the San Francisco Administrative Code

items.title: Folsom Area Stormwater Improvements Project within the neighborhood around 17th Street and Folsom Street
items.text: Approve Project No. CWWSIPFCDB14, Folsom Area Stormwater Improvements Project, and authorize the General Manager to implement the Project in compliance with the Charter and applicable law, subject to Board of Supervisors approval where required, to construct 12,500 linear feet of upsized Combined Sewer pipes and boxes within the neighborhood around 17th Street and Folsom Street, along with a new 4,500 linear feet wet weather tunnel of outside diameter 15 feet from the 17th and Folsom neighborhood, connecting to the Channel Consolidated Transport/Storage Box. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act, pursuant to Section 31.04(h) of the San Francisco Administrative Code

items.title: Issuance of up to $127 million of the 2021 Series AB Power Revenue Bonds
items.text: Discussion and possible action to authorize the Issuance of up to $127 million of the 2021 Series AB Power Revenue Bonds. The Commission resolution will approve the sale of the 2021 Series AB Power Revenue Bonds with an aggregate par amount not- to-exceed $127 million as follows: 2021 Sub-Series A (Green Bonds) and 2021 Sub- Series B Bonds, and approve the form of, and authorize the execution and delivery of, related documents; authorize the General Manager to sell the bonds in one or more series on a competitive basis the General Manager determines within the parameters of the Commission’s adopted “Debt Management Policies & Procedures” in the best financial interest of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission; and delegate to the General Manager authorization to award each series of bonds to the highest bidder (lowest cost)

items.title: Resolution establishing Commission priorities to guide the new General Manager as he assumes his responsibilities in the areas of Leadership, Sustainable Public Power, Integrity and Communications
items.text: Discussion and possible action to approve a resolution establishing Commission priorities to guide the new General Manager as he assumes his responsibilities in the areas of (1) Organizational Leadership, (2) Environmental Leadership, (3) Sustainable Public Power, (4) Capital Program Effectiveness and Integrity, and (5) Communications; that they will result in significant and measurable improvements in all priority areas; and that they will in turn guide the Commission in evaluating his performance. President Moran stated that the resolution is not intended to be a complete list of priorities nor is not intended to highlight the most important things the agency does, but that it is intended to capture elements that the Commission believes are important at this point in time. He stated it does not establish or revise policy. He noted that the resolution was made available to the public after the last meeting and that some comments were received in two primary areas. First, comments from BAWSCA were received indicating that as an important customer, the maintenance of the relationship between the SFPUC and BAWSCA should be included.
